extraction.document_summary: AIA Star Protector Plus is an accident and health protection plan for children from 2 weeks old, with coverage “till age 75.” It provides “comprehensive 5-point coverage” including (1) an “Accidental Death, Accidental Dismemberment and Burns Benefit,” (2) a “Monthly Catastrophe Cash Benefit (Accident)” that pays monthly up to 20 years if catastrophic disability occurs within 180 days of the accident, (3) “Medical Reimbursement Benefit (Accident & Disease)” for specified medical items, (4) “Daily Hospital Income Benefit (Accident & Disease)” up to a stated number of days, and (5) “Post-Hospitalisation Home Care Benefit (Accident & Disease).” Plan tiers are Plan 1/2/3 with different coverage amounts and hospital income rates (e.g., Daily Hospital Income: 30/day, 50/day, 100/day; Medical Reimbursement: 1,500, 3,000, 5,000). There is also an optional “Child Critical Illnesses Benefit” (Option 1/2/3: coverage amounts 30,000 / 50,000 / 100,000), convertible at the child’s adulthood, and it terminates on the policy anniversary following the child’s 21st birthday. A key limitation/caveat stated is that “waiting period and deferment period are applicable before the benefits will be payable,” and only up to 150% of the coverage amount may be paid for injuries arising from the same accident.
quality_notes: Document contains clear plan tables for Plan 1/2/3 and Optional Benefit options, plus a Schedule of Indemnity and specific benefit mechanics (ICU double indemnity, durations, reimbursement sub-limits).
Some underwriting/eligibility details (e.g., medical underwriting method) and key policy mechanics (e.g., free-look, grace period) are not stated explicitly.

policies.quick_summary: Worldwide accident and health protection for children (entry from 2 weeks to 16 years; coverage till age 75), with Plan 1/2/3 basic benefits including accidental death/dismemberment/burns, catastrophe monthly cash, medical reimbursement, daily hospital income (including ICU double indemnity), and post-hospitalisation home care. It also includes education assurance fund and multiple accident/disease reimbursement components; a separate optional Child Critical Illnesses Benefit (Option 1/2/3) can be converted and terminates after age 21. Waiting and deferment periods apply before benefits become payable.
